label: long Lamassu system
definition: A Lamassu system in which an organism possesses a locus from the long-LmuB family, characterized by longer coiled-coil regions in its SMC-like LmuB sensor than in short Lamassu systems.
observations: Long-LmuB structural family, not a length threshold or a type-II synonym. Existing effector-defined records are not reparented without scope reconciliation.
